speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Oh, this is pretty nice. Uh, the bedrooms are back there?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: That depends.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: I don't understand, their, their existence is conditional?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: No, but your ability to perceive their existence is conditional on you passing the second and third barriers.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: There's three?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Each more daunting than the last. Have a seat. No! That's where I sit!

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Okay.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: What's the difference?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: This seat is ideally located both in relation to the heat source in the winter and a cross breeze in the summer. It also faces the television at a direct angle allowing me to immerse myself in entertainment or game play without being subjected to conversation. As a result, I've placed it in a state of eternal dibs.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Can you do that?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Cathedra mea, regulae meae. That's Latin for my chair, my rules. Now, you said on the phone that your area of study is physics.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Uh, yeah, experimental physics. What is that?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Hmm.

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Doesn't concern you. You'll be going to the university every day? And you have a vehicle? And you'll be willing to drive me?

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Yes. A car, yeah.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Well, can't you drive?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: I can. I choose not to.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Okay, I suppose I could drive you. Well that's a point in my favour, right?

speaker: past_sheldon#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Why don't you let me do this.

speaker: past_leonard#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode22
text: Come on, I just asked.
